title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Mint 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing MINT by Vice, the latest addition to the Vice brand’s line of premium salt nicotine e-liquids. Enjoy the crisp and refreshing flavor of cool mint, perfectly balanced for a smooth and satisfying vaping experience.
Crafted with the same commitment to quality and attention to detail as Vice’s high-performance disposable vapes, this e-liquid is made with high-quality ingredients and available in a convenient 30ml bottle. Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or new to the vaping scene, MINT by Vice is the perfect choice for those seeking a satisfying and refreshing vape.
Experience the cool and invigorating taste of mint, with a smooth and satisfying finish. This e-liquid is the perfect choice for those looking for a simple and refreshing flavor, or those looking to mix and match with other flavors to create their own unique vaping experience.
So why wait? Try MINT by Vice today and discover the ultimate in vaping pleasure!
Flavour Notes:
Mint
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
